_source: Real Grafana Loki 3.7.9 answers recorded over HTTP on 2026-11-13 (single binary, auth_enabled: false, so X-Scope-OrgID was ignored; max_query_length 30d1h; max_query_lookback set). One row per Loki error class and route, and every tenant probe whatever Loki answered (not comparable: Loki ignored the tenant header; a success body is cut to 120 bytes): the request as sent (target, method, headers, form; generate rebuilds a request too large to store) and Loki's status, Content-Type, X-Content-Type-Options and body. msg and args name the internal/lokierr message and the typed inputs its constructor renders the text from; rows without msg are Loki messages no constructor renders yet. not_comparable says why a row cannot be compared with the proxy yet.
